verdict.rationale: Aider is a terminal/chat-driven pair-programming tool: you add files to a chat session and issue instructions (docs-1, docs-6), and even its --watch-files mode requires writing an explicit comment and saving before Aider steps in (docs-9, comm-17) — this is not real-time inline ghost-text completion or next-edit suggestion as you type. No evidence pack item describes an editor-integrated autocomplete/tab-completion experience.
